notes.title: Update Interface and Translations
notes.notes:
Game Update Now Live!

Hey everyone!
I've just pushed an update to the current Steam version of The Better Deal. Since I’m not allowed to add new story content here, this update focuses on improvements to the existing experience:

📝 What’s new in this update:

✨ Ukrainian and Russian translations have been fully revised and professionally localized for a much better reading experience.

🧭 The user interface has been improved, with in-game hints now added to every choice menu—just like in my first game, Beauty and the Thug.

🧩 Choices that were previously hidden due to low stats are now visible (but disabled), so you’ll always know what options were available and how to unlock them next time.

📌 A quick note:
Although this Steam version is still labeled as Part I, development has already reached version 0.7, and there’s a lot of new content beyond what’s currently available here—including expanded storylines, new scenes, and many more animations. Steam doesn’t allow me to update the game in Early Access, and I made a promise not to split the release into parts. I want to stay true to that and respect your trust.

But if you’re curious to learn more about what’s already been added, feel free to check my profile for links or… you know, the Internet tends to know where to look. 😉

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Achievements, Gallery, Cloud Saving, and 4 New Localizations
notes.notes:
🚀 Game Update Released! 🚀

Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce that I've just released a new update for The Better Deal! 🎉

What's New:

🌍 Added 4 new localizations: Brazilian Portuguese, German, Korean, and Italian! Now more players can enjoy the game in their native language.

🏆 Achievements are now available! Challenge yourself and unlock them all.

📸 A brand-new Game Gallery has been added, where you can view all the amazing moments you've captured during your journey.

☁️ Steam Cloud Saving is now supported, so you can seamlessly continue your progress across different devices.

Thank you all for your continued support! I can't wait to hear your feedback on these new features. Happy gaming!
